_comment: Tutorial for sols 1 to 5. Used in both Moon and Mars mode. The tutorial forces one solar particle event and turns off random events until free play.

steps.title: Power comes first
steps.text: Everything at the base runs on electricity. Build a Solar panel, then press End {day}.

steps.title: Make oxygen
steps.text: The crew is breathing the oxygen tanks dry. An Electrolyzer splits water into oxygen, but it needs power and water. Build one.

steps.title: Storm warning!
steps.text: The Sun flared. Radiation arrives next {day}. Build a Storm shelter now. It takes one {day} to finish, so it is ready just in time.

steps.title: Into the shelter
steps.text: The solar particle event is here. Your crew hides in the shelter and gets only a small dose. Without it they could get sick. End the {day} and read the report.
steps.text_if_missing: The solar particle event is here, and there is no storm shelter. End the {day} and read the report to see what radiation does to the crew. Build a shelter before the next one!

steps.title: You're in charge
steps.text: Now plan ahead: water (Ice miner), food (Greenhouse) and batteries. Greenhouses drink power and water, so build power first. There is no perfect base. Good luck!
